definitions.gloss: no argument; no questions asked; beyond discussion
definitions.explanation: Used to express that something is non-negotiable, or to describe a forceful action taken without discussion or warning. Literally means 'questions and answers are useless.'

examples.japanese: {問答無用|もんどうむよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{追|お}い{出|だ}された→追い出す：04625_oidasu⟧。
examples.english: I was thrown out without any discussion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}したら→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧{問答無用|もんどうむよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{減点|げんてん}→減点：16413_genten⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If you're late, you lose points — no questions asked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{問答無用|もんどうむよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Rule violations are subject to disciplinary action without discussion.

notes:
{問答無用|もんどうむよう} is a ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character compound) meaning that no discussion or argument is allowed. Literally: "questions and answers are useless."

FORMS:
{問答|もんどう} (questions and answers, dialogue) + {無用|むよう} (useless, unnecessary).

USAGE:
Conveys a forceful, non-negotiable tone. Often used to describe situations where someone acts decisively without giving the other party a chance to object.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {問答無用|もんどうむよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{追|お}い{出|だ}す→追い出す：04625_oidasu⟧: to throw out without discussion
- {問答無用|もんどうむよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to discipline without argument
- {問答無用|もんどうむよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{捨|す}てる→切り捨てる：05747_kirisuteru⟧: to cut down without a word

REGISTER:
Somewhat literary or dramatic. Common in historical dramas (⟦{時代劇|じだいげき}→時代劇：12968_jidaigeki⟧) and formal written contexts. In everyday speech, expressions like ⟦{有無|うむ}→有無：13019_umu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}わさず are more natural.
